facts.business: G S Auto International Limited is an Indian listed company engaged in manufacturing and selling auto components, with revenue recognition involving price variations passed on to customers.

auditor.name: C S Arora & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on identification of Micro and Small Enterprises based on representation by the entity and test checks as per ICAI standards (Refer Note 56 of Notes to Accounts).

key_risks: Significant judgement and estimate involved in calculation of price variations for revenue recognition at year end.
